fixes.explanation: Not the king this time, friend! Asaph is praying to God, so when he says "they form an alliance against You…" the "You" is God Himself. Hold on, a whole group of nations, one mind, one plan, and the target is God? I can't even get my two ovens to agree on one temperature!

Ooh, you went fancy, friend! I'd have grabbed the gold too, and I came with a 25 cent price sticker. But Ophir's gold isn't in this verse. The quote is "Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God." Not a shiny thing in sight, just pastures, and the psalm calls them God's.
